title: Diagnose zero sccache hits and fix the cache or revert it
summary: Find why sccache, wired in athena.toml for the change and study capabilities (D80), gets no hits. The suspects are the wrapper not applied or not installed, per-job paths, or the sandbox. Fix the wiring so a second build hits, or remove the sccache wiring if it can't help, and record the outcome.

defaults_applied.how: RM-0 item 1 in docs/design/roadmap.md supplies the hidden requirement: diagnose, fix, and record hits and misses.
The diagnosis must cite what was run and read. The user's figures are labeled as reported, not measured.
A unit test pins the sccache wiring in athena.toml, or its absence after a revert.
cargo test and clippy must pass.
One focused change, covering only the build cache. Concurrent jobs, PR landing and timings stay out.
The decision record and changelog are written for an outside reader.

assumptions: The 0 hits and 644+ misses come from the user's reports, which I did not measure; I could not run anything.

The producer can only run cargo build/check/test/clippy/fmt/run/metadata/tree/doc, so it cannot call sccache --show-stats directly. It may need to infer the cause from code, such as how env.rs expands {athena_home} and how checks and agents receive the env, or by running a cargo build through a small xtask or test.

Likely causes to check: the wrapper binary is missing or not installed because setup --ci skips it, the sccache server is blocked from starting or from using SCCACHE_DIR by the sandbox, absolute-path differences in per-job snapshots and target dirs change keys, the env is not applied to the check runs, or HOME and CARGO_HOME differences change registry source paths.
If the cause cannot be fixed within the permitted commands, the fallback is to revert, as the user allowed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A recorded diagnosis (new decision in docs/decisions.md) names the measured cause of the 0 sccache hits, citing the commands run and their output (sccache --show-stats before and after), or states that the cause could not be reproduced.

Either athena.toml is fixed so that both [capabilities.change.env] and [capabilities.study.env] apply a working sccache setup, or the RUSTC_WRAPPER, SCCACHE_DIR and CARGO_INCREMENTAL lines and the [tools.sccache] pin are removed from athena.toml, with the decision recorded (revert fallback). athena.toml is named in this criterion as the governance file changed.

Run `cargo test` from the repository root: all tests pass, including any new or updated test in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs or crates/athena-agent/src/env.rs that pins the chosen wiring (or its absence after a revert).
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`: both are clean.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry, and docs/design/roadmap.md RM-0 item 1 is updated to state the outcome (hit count recorded, or cache reverted) without claiming unmeasured numbers.
README.md and setup.sh text about sccache stay consistent with whether the pin remains.

out_of_scope: Concurrent jobs, native pull-request landing and timings reporting (the other RM-0 items).
Changing per-job target directories (D46) beyond what the cache diagnosis requires.
Changing CI workflows or adding sccache to CI.
departures: The reference was raised a little because the diagnosis cannot run sccache directly and may need several investigative cycles. The change is also open-ended: a fix or a revert.
